data.one_liner: Statistics package for data manipulation, mathematical functions, and Bayesian Networks.
data.what_it_does: Provides tools for statistical computations, Bayesian Networks, high-precision arithmetic (Decimal and DynamicInt), and CSV generation.
use_when: You need to compute mean, median, standard deviation, and other statistics on numeric collections.
You need to build and query Bayesian Networks for probability analysis.
You require high-precision decimal and integer arithmetic to avoid floating-point inaccuracies.
avoid_when: You need full-fledged data science or machine learning models beyond Bayesian Networks.
You require complex chart rendering or UI components for your statistics.
strengths: Includes built-in Bayesian Network support with variable dependency and event monitoring.
High-precision arithmetic classes (Decimal, DynamicInt) that expand precision dynamically.
Numeric extensions for rapid statistical calculations and CSV generation.
weaknesses: Limited to statistical calculations, Bayesian networks, and high-precision math tools.
Not documented for advanced charting or data visualization.
